csv_scope_of_work: The City of Fernandina Beach, Florida (City) is seeking a qualified and experienced for Fernandina Beach Marina Redevelopment in Fernandina Beach, Florida. Fernandina Beach Marina Redevelopment consist of the following. The demolition of Brett's Waterway Cafe and the removal of debris falling into the river; dredging; a new pier is to be constructed to have the entrance be more in align with Center Street with a single entrance to the marina including improved site views.
